title: 12th population census Mei 31, 1947 (housing census included)
descriptions: The dataset is based on three separate censuses of the Netherlands of 1947, population census (5+1 vols), occupational census (2 vols) and housing census (4 vols). Content: images of the publication, pdf files of the text sections and excel files with data entered from the published tables.
